title: Kirby Problem 1.7
exact_target: Ask for trapezoidal Alexander coefficients of alternating knots, a stronger log-concavity and signature bound for alternating links, and strict log-concavity of Conway coefficients for positive links.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2666 (KP-1.7). CC BY 4.0.
R. \.{I}nan\c{c} Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman, K3 -- A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology, author preliminary edition (2026), Problem 1.7 and its remarks.
